conflicts.detail: The indexed excerpt uses 'arial-modal'; the intended ARIA attribute is likely 'aria-modal'. Preserve the source wording and verify against the live page/code before correction.
The local govbr-ds-validator specification says 37 components, but its enumerated component list contains 36 unique names.
conflicts.resolution: O pacote oficial @govbr-ds/core 3.7.0 contém 36 diretórios de componentes e 172 exemplos. O valor 37 no documento local do validator é considerado incorreto ou desatualizado.

conflicts.title: Template Base references legacy CDN while current guide recommends avoiding it

sources.evidence: Current guidance recommends npm or local files instead of the legacy CDN.
63 packaged HTML files reference the legacy CDN.

conflicts.recommendedResolution: Treat npm/local installation guidance as current for new projects, while preserving template/package CDN references as legacy examples until official correction.

conflicts.title: Canonical package examples contain static accessibility anomalies
conflicts.recommendedResolution: Do not teach these exact fragments as compliant examples. The validator should flag missing alt and unresolved ARIA references.
